III. Read the passage and do the tasks below.

Đọc đoạn văn sau và hoàn thành các bài tập bên dưới.

My friend is Hoa. She is twelve years old and she is a very clever student. She always learns things quickly and easily. Hoa is also a caring person. She loves helping her friends when they have difficult exercises.

Today is Sunday. Hoa is not cycling to school. Right now, she is staying at home. Hoa is very creative, so she is drawing some beautiful pictures in her bedroom. She has lots of new ideas for her drawings. Hoa also likes music. This afternoon, she is writing an email to invite me to her house. We are going to make some sandwiches and play badminton together. We always stay in touch.

Task 1: Decide whether the statements are True (T) or False (F).
32. Hoa is a clever student who learns things very quickly.
33. Hoa is cycling to school with her classmates today.
34. Hoa is drawing pictures in her bedroom right now.
Task 2: Answer the questions. (Gõ câu trả lời ngắn)
D

→ She usually

MINI REVIEW - CỦNG CỐ KIẾN THỨC BÀI HỌC

Tóm tắt các từ vựng và cấu trúc quan trọng trong bài làm

Vocabulary (Personality Traits)

  • • clever /ˈklevər/: thông minh, lanh lợi
  • • active /ˈæktɪv/: năng động, hăng hái
  • • creative /kriˈeɪtɪv/: sáng tạo
  • • caring /ˈkeərɪŋ/: chu đáo, biết quan tâm
  • • hard-working /ˌhɑːd ˈwɜːkɪŋ/: chăm chỉ

Grammar Points

  • • Present Continuous (Thì hiện tại đơn & tiếp diễn):
    - Hiện tại tiếp diễn chỉ hành động đang diễn ra (dấu hiệu: now, right now, at present, Look!).
    - Cấu trúc: S + am/is/are + V-ing.
  • • Like + V-ing:
    - Diễn tả sở thích. Ví dụ: She likes drawing pictures.
  • • Sentence Transformation:
    - be interested in V-ing = like V-ing
    - Why don't we V...? = Let's V...
